title: E-QTM-0131: one ring behind the limits, partial: every amplitude of every word of link moves and meetings is in...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0131 in the quantum arena: one ring behind the limits, partial: every amplitude of every word of link moves and meetings is in Z[omega][1/6], and since 2 is inert in Z[omega] no single amplitude has $|x|^2$ = 1/2, so no word makes a 50:50 split or a fine-grained full Hong-Ou-Mandel dip, and a love-fear knot (whose ring is Z[omega][1/3]) can never reach CHSH = 2 sqrt 2; but like meetings bring the 2 in, and three of them reach Tsirelson's bound exactly.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
